Parametric bootstrap of a gcTMB model

Source: R/boot.R
bootstrap.Rd

Simulates responses from the fitted model, with new random effects (see simulate.gcTMB), and fits the model again to each simulated response, with the iteration limits of the fit (control in gcTMB), starting at the estimates. The bootstrap sample can be used for confidence intervals of the model parameters and of the times of timeto, see confint.gcTMB, without fitting the models again.

Usage

bootstrap(object, nsim = 500, seed = NULL, progress = interactive())

# S3 method for class 'bootstrap.gcTMB'
print(x, digits = max(3L, getOption("digits") - 3L), ...)

# S3 method for class 'bootstrap.gcTMB'
confint(object, parm = NULL, level = 0.95, ...)

Arguments

object

A gcTMB object, the result of gcTMB.

nsim

Integer. Number of simulations

seed

Integer or NULL. An optional seed for the random number generator

progress

Logical. Show a progress bar

x

A bootstrap.gcTMB object, the result of bootstrap.

digits

Integer. Number of significant digits in the printed output

...

Not used.

parm

Character or integer vector. Parameters, names or positions in coef; default all

level

Numeric between 0 and 1. The confidence level

Value

bootstrap returns a bootstrap.gcTMB object, a list with the estimates of coef(object) for each simulation (estimates, a matrix with NA rows for fits that did not converge), the fitted model (fit), and nsim and seed. confint returns percentile intervals of the parameters, on the scale of confint.gcTMB.

Examples

fit <- gcTMB(height ~ DAS, data=FabaHeights25)
bt <- bootstrap(fit, nsim=50, seed=1, progress=FALSE)
bt
#> Parametric bootstrap: 50 of 50 fits converged
#> 
#>                Estimate    Mean     Bias Std. Error
#> b1:(Intercept)  120.785 120.939 0.153923     3.2508
#> b2:(Intercept)   30.730  30.760 0.029935     0.6897
#> b3:(Intercept)   12.881  12.927 0.046524     0.8880
#> log_sigma         2.077   2.081 0.003391     0.0522
confint(bt)
#>                     2.5 %     97.5 %
#> b1:(Intercept) 115.486761 126.788667
#> b2:(Intercept)  29.413291  32.173617
#> b3:(Intercept)  11.447898  14.613563
#> sigma            7.353607   8.738824
